corrects.previous_count_method: Hayabusa log-metrics CSV sum plus Chainsaw --skip-errors correction
corrects.why_it_was_wrong: The +312,784 'correction' for Logs_Win11_2023/Security.evtx double-counted records Hayabusa had already included. Scanning that file alone yields 312,783 records and 2,592 EventID 4688; the corpus-wide EventID 4688 total is 8,603 either way. The old figure overstated the corpus by 4.7% and inflated every fp_per_million denominator.

EVTX_ATTACK_SAMPLES.known_limits: Contains no mimikatz command line: SigmaHQ's own mimikatz rule also scores no-hit here. Treat a detection miss as a corpus limit until a control rule proves otherwise.
